user.title: Add ULTIMEA soundbar
user.description: Select a discovered ULTIMEA Bluetooth soundbar or enter its BLE address. Setup probes the app protocol and only exposes capabilities the device answers safely.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant will connect once to identify {name}, select the ULTIMEA app transport, and probe supported capabilities before adding it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the soundbar
error.not_supported: The Bluetooth device did not expose a supported ULTIMEA app-control protocol

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device did not expose a supported ULTIMEA app-control protocol

init.title: ULTIMEA options
init.description: A persistent connection provides live physical-remote updates. On-demand mode releases the soundbar for the ULTIMEA phone app after the delay.
